token.desc:
Flare Network is a Layer 1 blockchain designed to extend the utility of XRP within the Ripple ecosystem by enabling smart contracts and decentralized finance. As the XRP Ledger does not natively support smart contracts, Flare allows XRP to be represented on its network (e.g. FXRP) and used in DeFi applications.

Key points:

Enables smart contract functionality for XRP
Allows XRP to be used in DeFi (lending, staking, yield)
Provides decentralized data via its native oracle system (FTSO)
Supports secure interaction with external data and networks

In practical terms, Flare expands XRP from a payments-focused asset into one that can participate in programmable financial applications.
token.name: FLARE NETWORK
